meta.rate_selection_rule: 2019-2023 only: screen |fight-clustered z| >= 3 and LOYO CV deviance improves; tier 1 = LOYO fight-bootstrap CI below zero; forward addition by LOYO CV; block on if its joint LOYO CV CI is below zero. 2024+ scored once, never used to select (revised in verification).
meta.notes: features are log rate ratios or log-odds differences vs the division prior of the fight year (backtest: priors_asof; live roster: fighters.json priors); z = (feature - mu) / sd with mu, sd from 2019-2023 backtest sides. Winner models are antisymmetric with no intercept. Rate models: one row per fight side, X attacking Y.
